findings: ToolCall.dict includes its id; ActionStep.to_messages embeds complete call dictionaries into text, and the error branch can additionally embed the first id.
ToolCallingAgent records the incoming tool id; absent structured calls use parse_tool_calls, whose text parser creates uuid4.
Agent memory is passed to model generation; the default cleaner maps tool-call/tool-response roles to assistant/user and preserves text content.
CodeAgent uses a step-derived id, so random identifiers are not inferred for every agent path.
The default completion-preparation parameter is required, subject to explicit model overrides; this is existing ordinary behavior.
limits: No external framework installed or executed; no model, environment API, or evaluator invoked.
No external quality degradation, cost saving, prevalence, or causal replication measured.
Identifier canonicalization and behavior/representation metric distinctions are already prior art.
This is a purposive source review, not a representative framework survey.
LangChain search hits were not followed to a validated content path and are not counted as findings.
